English: Pack Animal Post
A makeshift corral and tent for beasts of burden, enabling the first rudimentary commerce and travel through the wild frontier.
Waystation
A rough shelter and firepit for travelers and merchants, offering basic rest and resupply along primitive tracks.
Customs Booth
A small wooden hut and palisade where tolls and duties are levied on passing merchants, formalizing local trade authority.
Trade Depot
A fenced enclosure with guarded sheds for goods, providing a safe exchange point and attracting local markets.
Wagon Yard
A large, guarded yard with stables and repair sheds for merchant wagons, facilitating the swift movement and storage of goods.
Caravanserai
A fortified stone inn and courtyard, sheltering traders, animals, and wares, boosting long-distance trade and security.
Freight Warehouse
A sprawling, multi-story warehouse of timber and stone, allowing vast quantities of goods to be safely stored and inventoried for distant markets.
Trading House
A multi-roomed stone building for merchants, brokers, and record-keepers, centralizing negotiations and enhancing trade oversight.
Merchants' Exchange
A grand hall with vaulted ceilings, hosting merchant guilds, brokers, and notaries, where contracts are signed and fortunes made.
Grand Trade Terminus
An immense stone complex with towers, counting houses, vaults, and bustling markets, serving as the heart of international commerce and administration.
